transformations: This original project-authored expected-only plan contains no profiler capture and therefore required no value replacement.

expectedObservations: After the learner attempts Q11 Exercise 2, the runner should be either the exact-hash reviewed solution asset or a learner alternative with the same interface, stages, independent oracle, adjacent diffs, and source/build/binary hash contract. Before profiling, four separate correctness invocations should qualify 5x7, 33x35, 64x32, and 4096x4096; the excluded warm-up and every profiled process should then keep only the frozen 4096x4096 workload. In each invocation, every stage should independently reuse one stable output allocation and address, receive a checked complete quiet-NaN sentinel host-to-device fill before launch, and pass checked synchronization, complete readback, output-shape, every-element exact CPU-oracle, and no-sentinel-remains checks.
The declared 4096x4096 workload should retain two 67108864-byte global matrices and at most 4224 shared bytes per block under the 134221952-byte problem bound.

Actual version and bare help should agree with the matching exact-version owner CLI manual about config control and --import, --page raw, and --csv, freeze config_args=(--config-file off) when config control exists or config_args=() for a reviewed older CLI without that interface, never require --config-file off on 2022.3, and let the remaining exact-GPU section, metric, CUPTI, report-write/import, and non-admin counter gates produce qualifying records or retained blockers.
One excluded direct-process warm-up should precede exactly ten fresh profiler attempts retained in acquisition order.

Each qualifying attempt should contain only the four selected stage kernels and preserve explicit completion, replay, a primary report and report hash, plus a same-ncu imported raw CSV with import stderr, status, command, derivative hash, and report-to-CSV hash mapping.
The coalescing-direction comparison should support, reject, or leave inconclusive its global-access hypothesis without a predeclared metric value or timing winner.
The shared-memory-tiling comparison should support, reject, or leave inconclusive its global-access hypothesis without treating static address arithmetic as observation.
The padded-bank-layout comparison should support, reject, or leave inconclusive its shared-bank hypothesis without treating browser bank arithmetic as evidence.

A qualifying full batch should first retain node --version output v24.19.0 and a separate recorded exact Node.js 24.19.0 match, then pass the exact-hash reducer and complete ledger gate and summarize only the ten parent-report-hash-bound imported rows for each stage and selected metric using count=10, the median plus minimum and maximum, and the report/CSV hash chain, with no sample deletion.
claimBoundary: This expected-only fixture contains no recorded timing, metric name or value, speedup, bottleneck, winner, replay result, Node.js observation, or runtime observation. It also contains no CSV header observation or report or ledger value. The two static Apache-2.0 solution assets and any host-side Node.js or reducer execution create no CUDA evidence, Runnable Example, or Evidence Status.
